command:
set -euo pipefail; rm -rf interface/build interface/.svelte-kit; cd interface; npm ci --ignore-scripts >/dev/null; npm run build >/tmp/matrixhub-baseline-build-v2.log 2>&1; python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
root=Path('build'); rows={}
for p in root.rglob('*'):
 if p.is_file() and not p.name.endswith('.gz'): rows[str(p.relative_to(root))]=p.stat().st_size
print('BASE_TOTAL',sum(rows.values()),'FILES',len(rows))
Path('/tmp/matrixhub-base-sizes-v2.tsv').write_text('\n'.join(f'{p}\t{s}' for p,s in rows.items()))
PY
